content:
Hi everyone, QED is an open-source AI agent I built.

As validated by domain experts, it successfully helped solved an open PDE research problem. Specifically, it identified an appropriate Carleman weight function for a previously unsolved wave-equation problem on a semi-unbounded domain, which enabled the construction of Carleman estimates.

QED handled both the search for the function and the proof that it satisfies the required differential constraints in a single fully automated run, with no human intervention (about 4 hours AI running time).

Combined with my earlier announced project pdf-to-Lean (https://github.com/chenyang-an/pdf_to_lean) and other formalization tools, QED can serve as an idea engine for mathematical proving and formalization.

The mathematical side of this problem — including formulating the question, verifying the QED-generated proof, and other supporting mathematical work — was carried out by Qiao Zhuang (University of Missouri–Kansas City), Qihao Ye (University of California, San Diego), and Zhongqiang Zhang (Worcester Polytechnic Institute).

QED source code: https://github.com/chenyang-an/QED
